thread:
maria_marketing: Hey runtime team — quick ask before we finalize the launch blog. We need a small set of reproducible reruns that exercise edge tails (very short prompts, extremely long prompts, and adversarial punctuation-heavy inputs). Goal: include a sentence in the blog about percentile stability across edge cases.
aj_runtime: Sounds doable. Can you define exact payloads + target percentiles?
mar ia_marketing: Sorry typo — maria. Target 50/95/99 PPL and p95 latency. We also want cold-start vs warmed KV cache comparisons.
sophie_eng: For 'extremely long' do you mean 8k tokens or longer? what's the model family?
\lmaria_marketing: Targeting opensf-chat-30b and quantized variants we've discussed. Long = ~12k tokens (truncate to model max with sliding window). Short = 1-6 tokens.
aj_runtime: Ok. We'll need sample prompts and a small harness. Could you drop a sample .jsonl of ~20 prompts covering each bucket?
mar ia_marketing: Uploading a seed list in a sec. Also: include 10 adversarial prompts that break naive tokenization (emoji stacks, zero-width chars).
luis_research: Quick note — for quantized variants ensure we run both int8 and int4 profiles; some regressions only show up in int4 when KV folding behaves differently.
noah_prod: FYI we should capture per-request metadata: model_variant, quant_profile, cache_state (cold/warm), warmup_tokens, and seq_len. That data will be used in the chart labels.
aj_runtime: Agreed. We'll instrument the harness to emit CSV rows. Template: `ts,req_id,model,quant_profile,cache_state,seq_len,lat_ms,ppl`
mar ia_marketing: Perfect. Also can we get a tiny script example for how we trigger runs? e.g.:
```
# run batch via bench-harness
python tools/bench_harness.py --model opensf-chat-30b --quant int8 --input samples/edgecases.jsonl --warmup 50 --concurrency 16 --out results/case-int8.csv
```
aj_runtime: Nice. We'll run at three concurrency points: 1, 8, 32 to show latency vs throughput tradeoffs.
sophie_eng: Note: for 12k token runs we'll need to bump sequence allocation on some runners. I'll patch config `RUNTIME_MAX_SEQ=12288` on the test pool.
ci-bot: deploy started by sophie_eng — test-pool/config update queued (build 8843).
aj_runtime: Timeline: we can kick off runs tomorrow morning, will take ~3 hours to complete all combos. I'll post artifacts to GCS and share links.
luis_research: Add one more check: compare top-k sampling vs greedy for worst-case PPL variance. That helps marketing claim about quality retention under quantization.
mar ia_marketing: Great, include a short blurb we can quote: "No meaningful quality degradation observed at P95 under our int8 profile across targeted workloads (see appendix)." We'll adjust copy after results.
noah_prod: When you have results, pls include raw CSV + minimal notebook that reproduces charts (so analysts can re-run).
aj_runtime: Will do. I'll tag results with commit: bench/edgecases/2187654321 for traceability.
mar ia_marketing: Thanks team — please ping here when artifacts are uploaded. :pray:
